fnol_text: My name is Dana Mbeki and I live at 233 Briar Court, Dover, DE 19918. You can reach me on (555) 951-5294 or dana.mbeki@example.com. On 11 October 2026 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2025-00095. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Mbeki on (555) 951-5294 to acknowledge the claim. Dana confirmed the loss date as 11 October 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Leila Raman gave a statement by phone.
Dana sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
